notes: Tester round 2 (thanks Mirko!): knob moves out of Ω/diode/cap now reach DC volts — the ':DMM:CONFigure?' reply parser only recognized the long SCPI spelling 'VOLTage…', so terse echoes ('DCV', 'V AC') and range-style replies ('20V', '20MΩ') kept the old mode on screen; the mapper now understands all of these. AC selection shows up: when the firmware echo carries no AC/DC qualifier, one labeled ':READ?' probe settles it and the learned flavor survives later qualifier-less syncs (no flicker back to DC). Knob updates land in about 1 s instead of 2-3 s. Oscilloscope module: the OWON HDS200 (the same handheld the live multimeter uses) now appears in the CONNECT picker and works — it is a raw USB bulk device, so before this release it was in neither the WebUSB filter list nor the serial-port picker and the popup only showed unrelated hardware; the scope module now talks to it over the same proven transport, with keep-alive, link-drop self-heal, and a clear message if the Multimeter window is still holding the device.
